glass: large stemmed goblet (about 350 ml), chilled, no salt rim
version: v1 (round 4, 2026-09-30): a frozen Margarita made as Arnold's freezer batch (LI pp. 141-142: whole batch frozen a day ahead with its dilution water, lime added at the blend; target about 14%, sugar at most 9 g/100 ml). Cointreau recommended (Martinez's father 'always insisted on using Cointreau', VinePair 2021, Hester F16); syrup and Cointreau both, as in Martinez's printed recipe (F17), but not his proportions. Spark: pure vanilla extract in the batch, orange and vanilla (Matrix pdf 256: vanilla's best pairings include citrus; LI p. 271: Arnold adds a drop of vanilla extract to orange in his Orange Julius variant). No salt or saline (Making the Calls). Freeform because balance.py's blended style assumes ~90% ice melt and this drink has none; reference = Arnold's slushy daiquiri, 14.2% / 8.4 g / 0.93%.
